title: Root coordinates and normalized product-bar environment
statement: For the full parameter-root presentation [def-sfb-full-parameter-root-tower] of an actual Kummer chart [def-sfb-tame-root-chart-geometry], and finite inner and outer branch lists, define the inner root algebra and then the outer root algebra over it using the actual parameter images. The canonical successive-root specification is a ring equivalence from the full root algebra fixed on base coefficients and every named inner and outer root. A deck splitting is the continuous multiplicative coordinate reordering of the native full deck group, fixed on every coordinate. For a commutative profinite product-group scheme action on X over W, use the actual profinite parameter schemes and action-lift maps [def-sfb-profinite-coefficient-linearization]. Define the actual bisimplicial action nerve specification: degree (a,b) is the actual profinite parameter scheme of X with parameters G_o^a times G_i^b; all faces and degeneracies are the actual scheme-map equalities given by the usual multiplication/deletion and identity-insertion maps [lem-sfb-condensed-product-bar-comparison], with action on the first face. The diagonal is naturally isomorphic over W to the actual full Cech nerve, and its coordinate map is the canonical tuple-reordering followed by the existing full-root nerve coordinate map [def-sfb-kummer-nerve-coordinates]. This defines data, not an existence theorem, and includes empty parameter tuples and trivial outer group. A shared normalized full/product bar environment uses the existing full bar [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], product bar and resolution comparisons, specified exact inflation equality, and all three naturality squares for every compatible nonnegative resolution lift. Its iterated-invariant identification is the inverse iterated comparison followed by the canonical transport to the ordinary degree-zero object [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] and exact boundary point pullback after localization transport [def-sfb-kummer-bar-resolution]. This is data in a specification; no model is chosen from a postponed existence assertion.
